name: Spotify
author: idrewlong
description: Spotify on aarch64 Omarchy: keeps spotify-player running in the background and adds a music icon to the bar with a hover mini player (shuffle, previous, play/pause, next, repeat). Click it for the full TUI. Workaround for Spotify's official Linux client having no aarch64 build.

barWidget.description: Music icon with a hover mini player; click to open the full TUI
